# AGENTS.md — GitHub Actions

Run jobs on Windows runners (`windows-*` labels) under native `pwsh`. Native Windows build and process checks contribute to the pull-request `all checks passed` verdict; Wine runs Windows Node on hosted Linux only in `ci-master.yml`. Python runtime CI checks Linux/Windows x64 on pull requests and Linux ARM64 plus both macOS architectures on `main` or `master` pushes; releases retain all five targets ([platform policy](../.agents/notes/implemented/process/2026-09-06-master-only-platform-ci.md)). `ci.yml` is pull-request-only. Default-branch platform checks, Linux/Windows self-hosted standbys, and manual runner benchmarks live in `ci-master.yml`, which listens to `main`/`master` pushes and `workflow_dispatch`, not `pull_request`; separating workflow triggers keeps post-merge jobs out of PR check panels. The in-house standbys run only in `deepseek-harness/deepseek-harness`; downstream forks retain hosted platform checks. [Sandbox](workflows/sandbox.yml) also checks `main`/`master`, with its Blacksmith bwrap selector restricted to the same in-house repository identifier. Preserve the existing per-platform switches (values `selfhosted` for the in-house standbys and `blacksmith` for Blacksmith's hosted runners) and the Dependabot hosted fallback under the `selfhosted` values ([failover runbook](../.agents/notes/implemented/process/2026-07-26-ci-failover-runbook.md), [blacksmith failover leg note](../.agents/notes/implemented/process/2026-09-09-blacksmith-failover-leg.md)).
